linux_setup_welcome: Ho theha SP Flash Tool bakeng sa Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Khoasolla le ho hlophisa enjene e benyang e lebelo le holimo hore o tle o tsebe ho khutlisa le ho nchafatsa sebapali sa hau ntle le matla.
linux_card_engine_desc: Sesebelisoa sa tlhaho sa MediaTek se benyang se tsamaisanang le laeborari ea bokahohleng.
linux_card_usb_desc: E fana ka tumello ea komporo ea ho buisana le sebapali ka mokhoa oa Bootloader.
linux_card_grant_btn: Fana ka monyetla oa ho kena ka USB (1-Click)
system_checker_desc: Netefatso e felletseng ea bakhanni, li-module tsa kernel, litumello le lilaebrari tsa nako ea ho sebetsa ho netefatsa khanya e tšepahalang.
settings_checker_desc_installer: E etsa hore komporo ea hau e itokisetse ho hokela sebapali sa hau bakeng sa liapdeite tsa software.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: E lekola tlhophiso e tsoetseng pele ea Linux bakeng sa SP Flash Tool, phihlello ea USB, tumello ea serial, le likarolo tsa sistimi.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: E etsa hore komporo ea hau e itokisetse ho hokela sebapali sa hau le ho kenya liapdeite tsa software ka ts'epo.
settings_checker_desc: E etsa hore komporo ea hau e itokisetse ho hokela sebapali sa hau le ho kenya liapdeite tsa software ka ts'epo.

linux_prep_connected_friendly: Sebapali se fumanoe, se khatholla khokahanyo…
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: O ka hokela sebapali sa hau ha o botsoa.
linux_prep_blocked: Khomphuta ena ha e khone ho sebelisa SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Phasewete ea hau e hlokahala hang ho theha komporo ena bakeng sa ho benya: melao ea USB bakeng sa lisebelisoa tsa MediaTek le phihlello ea serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ho theha komporo ena bakeng sa SP Flash Tool, phasewete ea hau e tla hlokahala mohatong o latelang oa ho hlophisa melao ea USB le ho eketsa ak'haonte ea hau ho lihlopha tse hlokahalang tsa basebelisi ba serial. Haeba u hana, kopo e tla koaloa.
linux_prep_needs_access: Ho fihlella ha hoa ka ha fanoa, flashing e hloka eona.
linux_prep_fixed: Ho fanoe ka tumello, SP Flash Tool e se e loketse.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Ho seta ho felile 'me ak'haonte ea hau e kentsoe lihlopheng tsa basebelisi tse hlokahalang bakeng sa SP Flash Tool. Ka kopo qala komporo ea hau bocha hore litumello tse ncha li tle li sebetse, ebe u bula sesebelisoa hape. Tobetsa letšoao ho koala sesebelisoa hona joale.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: E felile, Koala App ho Restart Computer
settings_driver_desc: Pele o sebelisa sesebelisoa ka lekhetlo la pele, o tlameha ho kenya mokhanni oa MediaTek USB, ebe o qala komporo ea hau bocha.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Lokisa Litumello le ho Seta Sistimi
home_desc: Fumana firmware inthaneteng kapa khetha sephutheloana sa lehae, ebe u se khantša sesebelisoa sa hau.
home_step_1: Khetha mofuta oa sesebelisoa sa hau
home_step_2: Khetha software ebe u e jarolla
sel_source_desc: Khoasolla firmware inthaneteng, kapa kenya thepa ea lehae.
settings_advanced_desc: E bonts'a mokhoa oa ho instola, mokhoa oa ho instola le li-filters tsa tokollo.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Ntataise ka ho kenya ka har'a app
settings_guided_install_desc: Sesebelisoa se lula le uena ka ho tima, ho hokela le ho kenya.
settings_terminal_install: Kenya ho tsoa fensetereng ea terminal
settings_sp_gui_install: Kenya ho SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: E koala Updater 'me e bula SP Flash Tool GUI e nang le faele e khethiloeng ea firmware e hasanyang le litšoantšo tsa likarolo tse kentsoeng esale pele.
settings_terminal_desc: E tsamaisa kopo ea hau ea software ho Terminal hore o tle o bone lintlha tsa tekheniki mabapi le tsoelo-pele.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: E tsamaisa kopo ea hau ea software ho Command Prompt e le hore u bone lintlha tsa tekheniki mabapi le tsoelo-pele.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Taba ea boikhethelo. Lipheo tse ling tsa MediaTek li hana ho benya ho fihlela SP Flash Tool e fuoa faele ea netefatso (.auth); kenya ea hau mona haeba sesebelisoa se e hloka.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Ha ho faele ea scatter e fumanoeng ka har'a sephutheloana sena, kahoo ha ho taelo ea console e ka etsoang.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ha ho na SP Flash Tool kapa sebaka sa ho kena sa MTKClient se fumanehang bakeng sa mokhoa ona.
terminal_install_failed: Ha e khone ho bula fensetere ea theminale. Taelo ea ho kenya e ngotsoe ho {path}.
status_terminal_install: Kenya taelo e butsoeng fensetereng ea hau ea ho qetela ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} e tla bula e ntse e sebetsa {method}.

• Haeba ha e so tingoe, tima {device} ea hau.
• Haeba e hoketswe ho USB, e hakolle pele.
{hint}
• Hokela sesebediswa sa hao komporong ya hao ha {terminal_name} fensetere e butswe.

Tobetsa OK ho qala le ho tsoa ho Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Keletso: Haeba sesebelisoa se sa hokeloe ka bohona, tobetsa ka bonolo konopo ea ho seta botjha lesobeng la pinyo ka paperclip ha o ntse o hokela thapo ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Keletso: Kenya sesebediswa sa hao ho mokgwa wa ho jarolla firmware (e fapana ho ya ka moetso: mohlala, ntsha betri mme o e boloke ntle le thapo ya USB e hoketsweng, kapa tima o kentse betri, kapa o tshware Volume Down/Up ha o hokela USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Kenya ka SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI joale e tla bula ka firmware ea hau e kentsoeng esale pele.

• Ho SP Flash Tool, khetha "Download" ho tloha lebokoseng le theoha.
• Tobetsa konopo ea "Download".
• Etsa bonnete ba hore {device} ea hau e tingoe ebile e khaotsoe.
{hint}
• Hokela thapo ya USB khomphuteng ya hao ka mora ho tobetsa Download.

Tobetsa OK ho bula SP Flash Tool ebe o tsoa ho Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Ha e nolofalitsoe, lihlooho tsa Rockbox li fetisetsoa ho Y1 le Y2 ka bo eona ka mor'a ho kenya Rockbox e atlehileng.
themes_placement_failed_note: Ha rea ​​khona ho beha sephutheloana sa lihlooho ho sebapali sa hau. U ka leka hape ho Litlhophiso.
settings_rockbox_desc: E sebelisoa ha u bala lintlafatso tsa software.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Show Original Software litokollo tsa khale ho feta 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Litlhahiso tsa mantlha tsa Software tsa khale ho feta 3.0.7 ha li tsamaellane le likarolo tsa Y1 tse rekisoang ka Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ho khantša mohaho oa khale ho li-unit tsena ho tla li thibela ho qala ho fihlela mofuta o mocha o kengoa hape.

Na u na le bonnete ba hore u batla ho bonts'a litokollo tsa Original Software tsa khale ho feta 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: E bontša meaho eo zip ea ROM e leng mofuta oa 240p (rom…_240p.zip). 240p builds ha e tsamaellane le li-unit tsa Y1 ho Innioasis OS ka tlase ho 3.0.7, kahoo Show Old Rockbox Builds e lumelletsoe ka eona.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Likhatiso tsa Rockbox-Y1 pele ho 0.5 ha li tsamaisane le li-unit tsa Y1 tse rekisitsoeng kamora Hlakubele 2026 ka Innioasis OS 3.0.7 e kentsoeng pele.

Ho khantša mohaho oa khale ho lisebelisoa tsena ho tla thibela ho qala.

Na ehlile u batla ho hlahisa meaho ea khale ea Rockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Ka kopo, khetha .zip, .rar archive, kapa scatter file (*scatter*.txt) ka har'a foldara ea firmware ho kenya firmware eo u e khethileng ho {target} ea hau.
sel_offline: Lethathamo la Marang-rang ha le fumanehe hajoale. Sebelisa faele ea lehae, kapa hlahloba khokahano ea hau.
sel_no_release: Ha ho litokollo tse fumanehang bakeng sa software ena
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Ho fumanoe liphutheloana tse ngata tsa Firmware
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ho ile ha fumanoa liphutheloana tse ngata tsa firmware kapa lifaele tsa ho hasanya ka har'a foldara/boekhoe ba polokelo. Ka kopo, khetha sephutheli kapa polokelo e nang le thepa e le 'ngoe feela ea firmware ka nako.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Tokollo ena e na le lifaele tse fetang bonngoe tsa scatter, kahoo Updater ha e tsebe hore na sebapali sa hau se hloka sebopeho sefe. Moqapi oa {software} o tla hloka ho ntlafatsa lintlafatso tsa bona tsa firmware ho kenyelletsa faele e le 'ngoe feela ea ho hasanya.
sp_search_restart: Ha ho na sesebelisoa, se batla hape (ho leka {count}). Boloka sebapali se tima 'me u se kopanye ha u khothalletsoa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Faele ea netefatso ha e so fumanehe ({path}); e benyang ntle le yona.
sp_config_missing_platform: Faele ea ho hasanya ha e phatlalatse sethala sa eona, kahoo tlhophiso ea console bakeng sa faele ea netefatso e ne e ke ke ea hahuoa; e benyang ntle le yona.
sp_config_missing_storage: Faele ea ho hasanya ha e phatlalatse mofuta oa polokelo (EMMC/NAND/UFS), kahoo tlhophiso ea console bakeng sa faele ea netefatso e ne e ke ke ea hahuoa; e benyang ntle le yona.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Ha ho faele ea netefatso e fanoeng; ho benya ntle le enngwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Ha e khone ho ngola faele ea litlhophiso tsa console; e benyang ntle le faele ya netefatso.
settings_notifications_desc: Hlahisa litemoso tsa sistimi bakeng sa tsebiso le mefuta ea ntlafatso e ka tlase. Koala e boloka tsohle ka har'a app.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Lumella litsebiso ha sesebelisoa se koetsoe
settings_add_device_type_hint: Mofuta ke ntlafatso ea lisebelisoa tsa sebapali. Libapali tsa mofuta o le mong li ka hahuoa ka ntlafatso e fetang e le 'ngoe - mohlala Mofuta oa A le Mofuta oa B - mme software e etselitsoe e mong oa bona. Sheba setikara ka morao ho sebapali; haeba e sa bolele mofuta, tlohela khetho ea pele.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Ha ho na liphetolelo tse fumanehang bakeng sa software ena hajoale.
settings_add_device_pick_version: Khetha mofuta oo u tla o boloka.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Litsebiso tsa sistimi ha li fumanehe komporong ena.

settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Boloka sesebelisoa bareng ea menyu ka mor'a hore fensetere e koaloe, kahoo o ntse o fumana litsebiso tsa ntlafatso ea app le player firmware. E tima: ho koala fensetere ho emisa sesebelisoa.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Boloka sesebelisoa ka har'a terei ea sistimi ka mor'a hore fensetere e koaloe, kahoo o ntse o fumana litsebiso tsa ntlafatso ea app le player firmware. E tima: ho koala fensetere ho emisa sesebelisoa.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Pata lethathamo la marang-rang la sechaba 'me u kenye software ho tsoa lifaeleng tsa lehae feela.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: U khantšitse mohaho oa 360p Rockbox. O ka thabela ho kenya 360p Theme Pack sesebelisoa see hona joale?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Hokela Sebapali ho Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Ka kopo, hakolla USB, bulela 'me u qalelle ho Rockbox hang (kahoo e qala foldara ea eona ea kahare ea .rockbox), ebe o hokela USB hape ebe o khetha 'Mokhoa oa polokelo ea USB'.

Ha o hokahantsoe, tobetsa Tsoela pele ho khetha foldara efe kapa efe ho sebapali sa hau.

settings_allow_keep_data_any: Lumella ho Boloka Litlhophiso le Media ho kenya firmware efe kapa efe
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: E tlola potso e tsamaisanang. Sebelisa sena feela ha u na le bonnete ba hore sebapali se tla lula se sebetsa le litlhophiso tsa hona joale le mecha ea litaba.
err_keep_data_failed: Ha e khone ho boloka litlhophiso le mecha ea litaba: foldara ea firmware ha e ngoloe. Ha ho letho le kentsoeng.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: E boloka li-setting tsa hau le media ho sebapali. Lisebelisoa tse ling kaofela li kentsoe joalo ka tloaelo.
flash_keep_data_warning: Haeba u tsoela pele ntle le sena, litlhophiso tsa hau le mecha ea litaba e tla khutlisoa polokelong ea kahare ea sebapali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Haeba u tsoela pele ntle le sena, lihlooho tsa hau tsa Rockbox, lifonti le litlhophiso li tla tlosoa. 'Mino oa hau le litaba tse ling li tla lula ho sebapali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Haeba u tsoela pele ntle le sena, lihlooho tsa hau tsa Rockbox, lifonti le litlhophiso li tla tlosoa, 'me polokelo ea ka hare ea sebapali e tla tsosolosoa.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Haeba u tsoela pele ntle le sena, litlhophiso tsa hau li tla beoa bocha. 'Mino oa hau le litaba tse ling li tla lula ho sebapali.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware ena e tlameha ho fetola polokelo ea kahare ea sebapali. Litlhophiso tse bolokiloeng li tla hlakoloa; 'mino oa hau le mecha e meng ea litaba e tla lula e le teng.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware ena e tlameha ho fetola polokelo ea kahare ea sebapali. Litlhophiso tse bolokiloeng le media tse bolokiloeng polokelong e hahelletsoeng li tla hlakoloa. Mecha ea litaba ho microSD ea hau e lula e le teng.
format_all_confirm_question: Fetola sebaka sa polokelo ea kahare ho {model} ea hau?
format_all_confirm_body:
Bakeng sa {software} re hloka ho fetola sebaka sa hau sa polokelo sa kahare sa {model} pele re tsoela pele. Ebe teko e 'ngoe ea SP Flash Tool e tla lekoa, empa ka Format All + Download mode ka XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Hakolla USB, ebe u kenya paperclip kapa phini ka har'a khina e tsosolositsoeng ho {model} ea hau. Tobetsa E 'ngoe ho leka hape ka mokhoa oa Format All + Download.

Ho hobe le ho feta, sebaka sa bona sa Marang-rang se fana ka litemoso tsa zero le phihlello ea zero ho li-firmwares tse fetileng tse neng li sebetsa hore li hlaphoheloe maemong a litene. Ntlafatso ea le projeke ea Firmware ea Sechaba li nka likotoana: re boloka setoko se seng le se seng sa ROM, re netefatsa ka bo eona ntlafatso ea lisebelisoa tsa hau, 'me re boloke sebapali sa hau se sebetsa ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng.

support_story_1_item_2: Li-Archived Stock ROMs: Pokello e felletseng ea li-firmwares tsa mantlha tsa feme Innioasis e hlakotsoe.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Lisebelisoa tse benyang tse felletseng tsa macOS, Linux, le Windows ka ho tšoanang.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Ho iphumanela boto ka boto hore o lule o fumana sephutheloana se nepahetseng.
support_story_2_headline: Ha ho Google Drives e robehileng. Ha ho mosebetsi oa ho nahana. Firmware e sebetsang feela.
support_story_2_lead: Meaho ea sechaba ea lebelo le phahameng, e netefalitsoeng eo u ka itšetlehang ka eona.
support_story_2_body: Ho latela software ea semmuso ea Innioasis hangata ho bolela ho phenya liforamu tsa lihokelo tsa Google Drive tse felloang ke nako, likabelo tsa maru tsa Baidu tse shoeleng, le lifaele tsa zip tse makatsang tse se nang lisebelisoa tse benyang. Re thehile marang-rang a khoasolla a ikemetseng, a nang le bots'epehi bo tiisitsoeng ba SHA-256, litsebiso tsa ntlafatso, le ho kenya tataiso ea mohato ka mohato. Menehelo ea hau e boloka ka kotloloho tse jarollotsoeng le tse amohelang batho tse etsang hore sena se khonehe lihora tse 24 ka letsatsi, matsatsi a 365 ka selemo.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN e Phahameng ka ho Fetisisa: Khoasollo e potlakileng, e tobileng ntle le meeli ea ho jarolla kapa lihokelo tse shoeleng.
support_story_2_item_2: Litsebiso tsa Nchafatso: Fumana tlhokomeliso hang ha tokollo e ncha ea sechaba kapa litokiso li theoha.
support_story_2_item_3: Mehato e Tataisoang ea ho Kena: Litlhahiso tse hlakileng tsa pono li u tsamaisa ha u tobetsa konopo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
support_story_2_item_4: Sechaba sa Lipuo Tse Ngata: E fumaneha ka botlalo ka Senyesemane, Sechaena, Sejeremane, Sepanish, Sefora le Sejapane.
support_story_3_headline: Ho notlolla bokhoni bo felletseng ba sebapali sa hau sa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: E tlisa Rockbox, litsamaiso tse sebetsang tse bobebe, le tokoloho ea audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Software ea feme ea thepa e ngolla feela seo Y1 kapa Y2 hardware ea hau e ka se etsang. Sechaba sa rona se tlisitse Rockbox, lisebelisoa tse bobebe tsa tloaelo, ho bapala li-codec tsa audiophile, le lihlooho tsa tloaelo bophelong. Re reka mefuta e fapaneng ea lisebelisoa tsa 'mele ho tsoa ka pokothong ho etsa liteko, ho khutlisa boenjiniere, le ho netefatsa kopo e ngoe le e ngoe. E tšehetsa Updater ka kotloloho e tšehetsa likarolo tsena tsa liteko mme e potlakisa nts'etsopele ea firmware ea tloaelo.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Ho bapala ka audiophile le lihlooho tse ikhethileng tse kentsoeng ka metsotsoana.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ea Sechaba: Lintlafatso tsa betri, UI e hloekileng, le tšehetso ea sejoale-joale ea audio codec.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Re leka ka lisebelisoa tsa 'nete pele re lokolla moaho ofe kapa ofe.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% mahala, software ea lekunutu ea pele e se nang lipapatso kapa ho lateloa.
support_story_4_headline: Re thuse ho etsa seo Innioasis e sa se etsang.
support_story_4_lead: Tšireletso ea firmware e tsamaisoang ke sechaba e bolokang lisebelisoa tsa hau hore li se ke tsa qhaloa.
support_story_4_body: Ha k'hamphani ea Hardware e fetela sesebelisoa sa eona se latelang, mefuta ea khale ea tloheloa. Innioasis ha e fane ka tšehetso ea Linux, ha ho na liphetoho tse pepeneneng, 'me ha ho mokhoa o bonolo oa ho hlaphoheloa ha kopo e hloleha. Updater e teng hobane basebelisi ba chesehang ha baa lokela ho lahla sebapali sa mmino se hantle ka ho fetesisa. 100% ea litlatsetso tsa sechaba e kenya letsoho ka kotloloho ho boloka sesebelisoa sena se bulehetse bohle.
support_story_4_item_1: Pholoso & Unbrick: Pholiso e netefalitsoeng ea phalla leha lisebelisoa li hana ho qala.
support_story_4_item_2: Ts'ehetso ea Sehlopha sa Pele sa Linux: MediaTek e tšehelitsoeng ka botlalo e khanyang ho Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Lintlha tse qaqileng tsa tokollo e le hore u tsebe hantle hore na ke liphetoho life.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% e Tšehetsoang ke Sechaba: Kofi e 'ngoe le e' ngoe e boloka polokelo e bulehile ebile e sa lefelloe bakeng sa bohle.

err_sp_enable_dram: Sesebelisoa ha se khone ho qala mohopolo oa sebapali. Sebelisa sephutheloana se etselitsoeng mohlala ona hantle.
err_sp_storage_read: Sesebelisoa ha se khone ho bala polokelo ea sebapali. Sheba khokahano; sesebelisoa se ka ba le phoso ea hardware.
err_attempt_timeout_title: Sesebelisoa ha sea ka sa arabela
err_attempt_timeout: Sesebelisoa se benyang ha se bontše tsoelo-pele nakong ea metsotsoana e {seconds}, kahoo teko ena e ile ea emisoa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ha re khone ho theha khokahano e tsitsitseng le sebapali. Netefatsa hore sesebediswa se timilwe (sebedisa phini ho tobetsa konopo ya ho seta botjha ha ho hlokeha), ntsha USB, ebe o hokela hape ha o laelwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ho benya ho ile ha sitisoa kapa mosebetsi oa ho ngola o hlolehile. Lekola hore thapo ya USB e hoketswe ka thata le hore betri e na le tjhaji e lekaneng, ebe o leka hape.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Ho bonahala eka flash e tsitsitse
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Sesebelisoa se benyang se bonts'itse mohala o tšoanang bakeng sa metsotsoana ea ho qetela {seconds} mme ha e bonahale e tsoela pele ho ngola firmware. Ho ka etsahala hore ebe flash e hlōlehile. Haeba ena e ne e le boiteko ba ho qetela ho tse peli ka mokhoa o mong le o mong tsamaisong e ka oelang morao pakeng tsa bona, kapa haeba feela MTKClient e fumaneha mochineng ona, qala k'homphieutha bocha 'me u leke hape.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Ke MTKClient feela e fumanehang bakeng sa ho kenya sena. Ho ka etsahala hore ebe flash e hlōlehile. Ka kopo qala komporo hape 'me u leke hape.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Khomphuta ena e ka kenya le SP Flash Tool. Haeba o khona, fetohela ho SP Flash Tool ebe o leka hape.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Ho ka etsahala hore ebe flash e hlōlehile. Ka kopo bala molaetsa o ka holimo ebe o qala komporo bocha pele o leka hape. Haeba o tobetsa OK, sesebelisoa se tla emisa hore o ka qala bocha.
err_missing_package_files_title: Sephutheloana sa Firmware se sa sebetseng
err_missing_package_files_desc: Sephutheloana sa firmware ha se na faele ea ho hasanya kapa lifaele tse hlokahalang tsa setšoantšo. Ka kopo, khoasolla sephutheloana hape kapa khetha faele e felletseng ea firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Faele ea netefatso ha e sebelisoe
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Faele ea netefatso eo u e khethileng ha e eo, ha e na letho kapa ha e khone ho ngoloa. Khetha faele e nepahetseng, kapa e hlakole ho Litlhophiso, ebe u benya hape.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Sesebelisoa sa Flashing ha se Fumanehe
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Sesebelisoa se benyang kapa bakhanni ba sistimi e hlokahalang ha e khone ho qalisoa. Ka kopo, sheba litumello tsa sistimi, ho seta bakhanni, kapa kenya sesebelisoa hape.
err_driver_missing_desc: Phoso ena e ka etsahala ha mokhanni oa MediaTek USB a sa kengoa. Tobetsa Khoasolla Bakhanni ho kenya mokhanni oa MediaTek USB, qala komporo ea hau bocha, 'me u leke hape.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Faele ea "cached firmware" ha e eo. Khetha Khetha Software ho tsosolosa lifaele tse nkiloeng kapa ho khoasolla boitsebiso ba "firmware" hape. Bona ke bothata ba faele ea lehae, eseng bothata ba khokahano ea USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Khutlela ho Khetha Software ho aha bocha kapa ho jarolla sephutheloana sa firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Khetha tokollo ea firmware eo u tla e khoasolla hape.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Phoso e sa lebelloang e etsahetse nakong ea ho kenya ({detail}). Tlosa sebapali ka botlalo, se hokahanye hape ha u khothalletsoa, ​​'me u leke hape.
flash_method_confirm: Mokhoa oa ho kenya o fetotsoe ho {method}. Netefatsa hore sebapali se ntšitsoe 'me se tima, ebe u tobetsa E latelang.
flash_failover_note: {method} ha ea qala ho kenya. Ka mor'a hore sebapali se tima 'me se hlakoloe, {other} e tla sebelisoa ho e-na le hoo.
themepack_card_desc: E kenyelletsa lihlooho tse ntle tsa sechaba, lithaole tsa morao-rao tse nang le qeto e phahameng, le lifonti tse etselitsoeng lipontšo tsa 360p ka ho khetheha.
themepack_installed_success: 360p Theme Pack e kentsoe ka katleho!
themepack_step1_title: Mohato oa 1: Hokela ho Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Bulela sebapali sa hau ka ho tšoara konopo ea Matla.
2. Ha Rockbox lirifi, plug thapo ya USB khomphuteng ya hao.
3. Haeba o khothalletsoa skrineng sa sebapali, netefatsa mokhoa oa polokelo ea USB hore sesebelisoa se hlahe e le drive.
themepack_step2_title: Mohato oa 2: Khetha Folder efe kapa efe ho Player
themepack_step2_desc: Hobane lits'ebetso tsa ts'ebetso (tse kang macOS) li pata li-dotfiles (joaloka .rockbox) ka mokhoa o ikhethileng, o ka khetha foldara E MANG kapa efe kapa motso oa drive ho sebapali sa hau. Re tla u fumanela kapa ra u etsetsa buka ea .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Theme pack e kentsoe ka katleho! Joale u ka hakolla sebapali sa hau ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng ebe u khetha tema ho Rockbox (Litlhophiso> Litlhophiso tsa Theme).
themepack_err_not_found: Ha e khone ho fumana kapa ho qala .rockbox directory ho drive e khethiloeng. Ka kopo etsa bonnete ba hore u khethile sephutheli ho sebapali sa hau.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Tlolela ho Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Mohato oa 1: Qala sebapali hape 'me u kopanye hape
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Hakolla thapo ea USB.
2. Matla sebapadi khutlela 'me e ke e Boot ka Rockbox.
3. Hang ha Rockbox e sebetsa, hokahanya thapo ea USB hape, ebe o tobetsa Tsoela pele.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Mohato oa 2: Ho batla sebapali ho feta ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Sesebelisoa se shebile khokahano ea ADB (ho fihlela metsotsoana e 30). Haeba sesebelisoa se fumanoa, lihlooho lia fetisoa 'me sebapali se qala hape. Ho seng joalo, fetela pele ho Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: E emetse sesebelisoa sa ADB... (ho fihla ho metsotsoana e 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Sesebelisoa se fumanoe ({serial}); ho fetisa lihlooho...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ha ho sesebelisoa sa ADB se fumanoeng ka mor'a metsotsoana e 30; ho tsoela pele ka Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ha ho ADB binary fumaneha ho app e; ho tsoela pele ka Mokhoa oa polokelo oa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ho sutumelletsa lihlooho le mengolo holim'a ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Phetiso ea ADB e hlolehile; ho khutlela ho USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Numella USB Storage Mode ho sebapali e le hore se hlahe e le koloi.
2. Khetha foldara E MANG KAPA EFE ho sebapali se ka tlase (.rockbox, Music, Themes, kapa motso oa drive, foldara e patiloeng ea .rockbox e fumaneha ka bo eona).
3. Sesebelisoa se kopanya lihlooho le lifonte tsa 360p, se hlakola lifaele tsa mabitso a tšoanang.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: Lihlooho tsa 360p le lifonti li kentsoe!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Hona joale o ka khaola sebapali ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng ebe o khetha sehlooho ho Rockbox (Litlhophiso> Litlhophiso tsa Theme).
rockbox_stage_installing: E kenya Themes & Fonts tsa Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_step: E tlosa litlhophiso tsa khale tsa Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: E tlosa sephutheli sa .rockbox ho sebapali...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software ea hau e ncha e kentsoe, empa sephutheli sa khale sa .rockbox ha se khone ho tlosoa. Hlakola foldara ea .rockbox ho sebapali ka letsoho haeba u batla qalo e hloekileng.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Ho hoketsoe libapali tse fetang bonngoe. Hakolla tse ling 'me u siee e kentsoeng feela.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Sebapali se fumanoe. E bea meralo ea sechaba le mengolo...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Ho beha lifaele tsa theme ({curr} of {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Tšoara konopo e bohareng ho kenya matla ho Y1 ea hau, hokela USB hape, ebe u khetha Mokhoa oa polokelo ea USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Tšoara konopo ea matla ho matlafatsa sebapali sa hau, hokela USB hape, ebe u khetha Mokhoa oa polokelo ea USB.

2. Tobetsa 'Browse Folder...' ho khetha sebapali sa hau le ho kenya lihlooho.

err_storage_full_desc: Khomphutha ea hau e feletsoe ke sebaka sa polokelo. Ka kopo, bula sebaka sa disk ho drive ea hau ebe u leka hape.
